CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSECURITIESPORTFOLIO_SEC_v2] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio AS (
	SELECT 
		BSP.ID AS CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
		,BSP.REFDATE AS Datestamp
		,BSP.SECURITY AS Security
		,BSP.ENDSHARES AS EndShares
		,BSP.ENDVALUE AS EndValue
        ,BSP.CUSTCODE AS BossInternalAccountId
		,ACCT.ACCTCODE AS CustomerAccountId
		,BSP.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,getdate() AS InsertDttm
	FROM BUSC.SEC_PORTFOLIO BSP
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS ACCT ON 
    BSP.CUSTCODE = ACCT.ACCTKEY 
    WHERE BSP.isLatest = '1'
    AND ACCT.isLatest = '1'
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(bigint,CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId)
			,convert(datetime,Datestamp)
			,convert(varchar,Security)
			,convert(numeric,EndShares)
			,convert(numeric,EndValue)
            ,convert(nvarchar,BossInternalAccountId)
			,convert(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
			)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			convert(bigint,CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId)
			,convert(datetime,Datestamp)
			,convert(varchar,Security)
			,convert(numeric,EndShares)
			,convert(numeric,EndValue)
            ,convert(nvarchar,BossInternalAccountId)
			,convert(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
			)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId,TGT.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId) AS CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
		,CASE
			WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'    
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId = TGT.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA;


INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio(
	CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
	,Datestamp
    ,Security
	,EndShares
	,EndValue
    ,BossInternalAccountId
	,CustomerAccountId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT     
	 SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId
	,SRC.Datestamp
    ,SRC.Security
	,SRC.EndShares
	,SRC.EndValue
    ,SRC.BossInternalAccountId
	,SRC.CustomerAccountId
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,SRC.TaskRunId
	,SRC.WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId = SRC.CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolioId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio_DELTA;

END
GO
